card.$description: Corner radius of the standard card (BR-12). Uses the `container` radius role, the `radius.lg` step (ADR-0050, TBD-10).
Outline stroke width of the standard card, and of the dividers between its parts (BR-13).

bg.$description: Fill of the standard card: the pure black page (BR-03, ADR-0053), through `color.surface.card`. It is separated from the page by its outline, never by a different fill (C-05).

highlight.$description: The neon highlight of the standard card: its outline is brand pink (BR-01, BR-12). Chosen by the owner in ADR-0018.

divider.$description: Color of the lines between the header, body, and footer of the standard card: brand pink, like the outline (ADR-0018).

fg.$description: Title and body text of the standard card.

fgMuted.$description: Description text of the standard card.
